description: Adds or updates custom fields in the Cognigy.AI contact profile schema of a project. Built-in fields (firstname, email, ...) always exist; existing custom fields not listed are kept. MUTATING: Set dryRun=false to update.

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without updating. Set to false to actually update.

projectId.description: The project ID to set the profile schema for

schema.description: Custom fields to add or update. Existing custom fields with the same internal name are replaced; others are kept.

internal.description: Reference name used in code, e.g. profile.<internal>

name: set_contact_profile_schema
